talks.title: Backrow live demo
talks.abstract: Snap a slide, keep the talk. Live demo at the Cloud Native Hackathon.

talks.title: Give your agent Radar: ship and debug on Kubernetes
talks.abstract: Getting a team environment, connecting a coding agent to Radar, shipping through it, and watching an AI SRE explain why a release broke.

talks.title: Platform engineering in production: what we would do differently
talks.speakers: Platform leads from a retailer, a bank and a SaaS startup
talks.abstract: Three platform teams compare notes on internal developer platforms: golden paths people actually use, paved-road templates versus freedom, measuring developer experience, and the multi-cluster mistakes they would not repeat.

talks.title: Surviving a region outage: multi-cluster failover on Kubernetes
talks.abstract: How a retail platform runs active-passive across three clusters in two regions: health checks, global load balancing, data replication, and the failover runbook that cut recovery from hours to under a minute, plus what broke on the way.

talks.title: Observability for platform teams: from golden signals to SLOs with OpenTelemetry
talks.abstract: Rolling out OpenTelemetry across hundreds of services: collector topology, sampling that keeps the interesting traces, turning golden signals into SLOs and error budgets, and alerting on burn rate instead of noise.
